app.name: BabySmash
app.short_description: Let your baby smash buttons safely
app.long_description:
A Wii port of Scott Hanselman's BabySmash. Mash any button, key or mouse button and colourful shapes, letters and numbers pop up with giggles and spoken names. Type a word and the letters line up and say it.
Works with Wiimote (IR pointer), Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pad, Wii U Pro Controller, Wii U GamePad, DualShock 3, USB mouse and USB keyboard.
Hold Ctrl-Shift-Alt-O (or + and - together, or all three mouse buttons) for 3 seconds for options, including Save screenshot (also F12 / Print Screen, or hold 1 and 2 for 2 seconds). Quit with Alt-F4, or hold HOME for 2 seconds.
Original BabySmash by Scott Hanselman (MIT). Spoken clips by espeak-ng.
